  "working_thesis": "Hannah Arendt's political thought and her phenomenological distinctions between the earth and the world, as well as indoors and outdoors, can help make sense of artificial adaptations to a warming planet (carapace, prosthesis, enclosure) and the ways these adaptations narrow human receptivity, while also revealing the limits of her framework in addressing planetary-scale inequality and the politics of the people out of doors.",
